    • Employment: Would lead to less qualified individuals being hired, reducing productivity, innovation, and competitiveness.
    • Education: Would lower academic standards and deprive institutions of diverse perspectives crucial for intellectual growth, ultimately harming the quality of education for everyone.
    • Government Benefits: Would misallocate resources away from those with the greatest need, regardless of race, undermining the social safety net's purpose.
